$comment: The one table of old setting names: a settings file that uses one fails to load, naming the new setting (or why it was removed). Keys are dotted names ([] = every item of a list, <name> = any key of a map); env:NAME is an environment variable. See scripts/pipeline/lib/settings.mjs.

implement.preOpen.enabled.removed: every pipeline PR now opens finished (all agent work done, CI proven on its head), and an open PR that agents work on again is held (implement.preOpen.afterOpen); remove the setting

implement.preOpen.failedStory.removed: a story whose PR check or CI never passes now always escalates on its ticket, with its branch pushed, the findings on the ticket and no PR; remove the setting

analysis.reports.keep.note: factory prune keeps the newest analysis reports; the pipeline never pruned them itself

implement.ciFixRounds.note: counts every CI fixing round, before and after the PR opens

implement.preOpen.draftCycles.note: one count of every CI fixing round, before and after the PR opens

implement.retryDelaySec.note: the wait now doubles each retry

implement.parallel.note: an upper limit on the number worked out from free memory; `--parallel N` still forces N

resources.maxParallel.note: an upper limit on the number worked out from free memory; `--parallel N` still forces N

implement.prCheck.mode.note: one mode for single tickets and epics

implement.epic.prCheck.note: one mode for single tickets and epics

resources.roslynGb.removed: it was the old name of resources.lspServerGb; use resources.lspServerGb

review.note: the section is named after its stage

loops.consecutivePasses.removed: a test stage is verified once its council passes; nothing asks for a repeated pass on unchanged work

council.rounds.removed: every stage has its own round limit: implement.maxCouncilRounds, architectureReview.maxCouncilRounds, testPlan.maxCouncilRounds, testAutomation.maxCouncilRounds, prCheck.maxCouncilRounds

council.passScore.removed: every stage has its own pass score: implement.councilPassScore, architectureReview.councilPassScore, testPlan.councilPassScore, testAutomation.councilPassScore, prCheck.councilPassScore

council.stages.<stage>.rounds.removed: use the stage section's maxCouncilRounds (implement, architectureReview, testPlan, testAutomation or prCheck)

council.stages.<stage>.intercom.removed: use the stage section's councilIntercom (implement, architectureReview, testPlan, testAutomation or prCheck)

council.stages.review.removed: council members come from models.pool; seat several with council.members or architectureReview.councilMembers

agent.cli.removed: each models.pool entry names its CLI; models.agents.default is the entry an agent with none of its own runs on

agent.allowedModels.note: list each model once as a pool entry: name, cli, the CLI's model id and effort

agent.modelIds.note: a pool entry holds the CLI's own model id

agent.strictModels.removed: every agent runs on a models.pool entry, so nothing outside the pool can run

agent.models.default.note: the value names a models.pool entry: its name, cli, the CLI's model id and effort

agent.models.implementer.note: the implementer is the implement stage's orchestrator; the value names a models.pool entry: its name, cli, the CLI's model id and effort

agent.models.plan.note: the value names a models.pool entry: its name, cli, the CLI's model id and effort

agent.models.automation.note: the value names a models.pool entry: its name, cli, the CLI's model id and effort

agent.models.verifier.note: and models.agents.test-automation-verifier; each names a models.pool entry

agent.models.reviewer.note: the value names a models.pool entry: its name, cli, the CLI's model id and effort

agent.models.bugTriage.note: the value names a models.pool entry: its name, cli, the CLI's model id and effort

agent.models.escalationQuestions.note: the value names a models.pool entry: its name, cli, the CLI's model id and effort

agent.models.narrator.note: the value names a models.pool entry: its name, cli, the CLI's model id and effort

agent.models.audit.removed: the retro's audit re-check runs on the verifier's own models.agents entry

agent.models.<agent>.note: keyed by agent name (as in agents/); the value names a models.pool entry

agent.available.models.removed: factory init writes the models you have as models.pool entries

modelClasses.removed: there are no size classes: the planner names a models.pool entry per subtask, from implement.subtaskModels

implement.maxLargeSubtasks.removed: there are no size classes: the planner names a models.pool entry per subtask, from implement.subtaskModels

implement.roles.removed: each implement agent names its models.pool entry in models.agents (implementer, pair-verifier, pair-ui-verifier); a subtask's pair implementer runs on the entry the planner picks from implement.subtaskModels; a role's env goes on the pool entry

env:PIPELINE_VERIFIER_CLI.removed: the pair verifiers run on their models.agents entries (pair-verifier, pair-ui-verifier) from models.pool

prCheck.models.removed: each PR check agent (pr-check-judge, -acceptance, -flow, -design, -style, -video, -defender, -fixer) names its models.pool entry in models.agents

video.script.model.note: the value names a models.pool entry: its name, cli, the CLI's model id and effort

council.stages.removed: council members come from models.pool: council.members (or a stage section's councilMembers) says how many sit; lenses are no longer settings

env:PR_CHECK_MODEL_JUDGE.removed: name the models.pool entry in models.agents.pr-check-judge

env:PR_CHECK_MODEL_ACCEPTANCE.removed: name the models.pool entry in models.agents.pr-check-acceptance

env:PR_CHECK_MODEL_FLOW.removed: name the models.pool entry in models.agents.pr-check-flow

env:PR_CHECK_MODEL_DESIGN.removed: name the models.pool entry in models.agents.pr-check-design

env:PR_CHECK_MODEL_STYLE.removed: name the models.pool entry in models.agents.pr-check-style

env:PR_CHECK_MODEL_VIDEO.removed: name the models.pool entry in models.agents.pr-check-video

env:PR_CHECK_MODEL_DEFENDER.removed: name the models.pool entry in models.agents.pr-check-defender

env:PR_CHECK_MODEL_FIXER.removed: name the models.pool entry in models.agents.pr-check-fixer

implement.orchestrate.removed: the implement stage's orchestrator decides: it implements the ticket itself or plans subtasks for pairs (implement.orchestrator.model sets its pool entry)

implement.orchestrator.enabled.removed: the implement stage's orchestrator decides: it implements the ticket itself or plans subtasks for pairs

env:IMPLEMENT_ORCHESTRATE.removed: the implement stage's orchestrator decides whether it implements the ticket itself

models.agents.implementer.note: the implementer is the implement stage's orchestrator
